description:
Activate Food Chain by exiling Khan, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Cast Khan from exile by paying its mana cost, leaving one mana of that color unspent.
Khan triggers, allowing you to sacrifice another creature or artifact and causing you to draw two cards if you do.
Repeat, altering the color of mana added in Step 1 every few loops as desired.
